roster.name: Sorin Mercer
roster.bio: Originally from Absalom Station, they left a corporate security contract over unpaid wages. Sorin uses dry humor when a plan starts to unravel and is collecting enough experience to lead a rescue crew.
roster.quirk: hums a tune before opening an airlock

roster.name: Selen Haven
roster.bio: Originally from an independent habitat in the Diaspora, they left a research expedition when its funding disappeared. Selen uses dry humor when a plan starts to unravel and is collecting enough experience to lead a rescue crew.

roster.name: Quibbi Dawnpatch
roster.bio: Originally from the outer docks of Absalom Station, they left a research expedition when its funding disappeared. Quibbi celebrates small victories with the whole crew and is sending money back to their home community.
roster.quirk: sends postcards from every inhabited stop

roster.name: Oshrit Korra
roster.bio: Originally from a chosen community on Absalom Station, they left a corporate security contract over unpaid wages. Oshrit prefers a clear agreement to a reassuring speech and is searching for a missing former colleague.
roster.quirk: trades recipes with every new crew

missions.name: A Quiet Room at Tideglass Annex
missions.description: Meridian Free Clinic requests this operation: Reach a whistleblower recovering from an attack at Tideglass Annex, stabilize the situation, and move them to a confidential safehouse. Tideglass Annex is a pressure-sealed research annex above the cloud layers; the annex must share its emergency transit windows with civilian traffic. An old mutual-aid agreement at Tideglass Annex protects people the current security charter does not recognize.
missions.loreHook: An old mutual-aid agreement at Tideglass Annex protects people the current security charter does not recognize.
phaseObjectives: Establish trust and gain access to the protected person.
Handle injuries or medical complications.
Leave without exposing the safehouse route.

missions.name: The Record That Survived
missions.description: Research Consortium requests this operation: Reach a survey stations final data recorder at Tideglass Annex, recover its readable records, and keep them intact on the way out. Tideglass Annex is a pressure-sealed research annex above the cloud layers; the annex must share its emergency transit windows with civilian traffic. An inventory found at Tideglass Annex lists an extra compartment absent from the insurers diagrams.
missions.loreHook: An inventory found at Tideglass Annex lists an extra compartment absent from the insurers diagrams.
phaseObjectives: Reach the protected archive without alerting claimants.
Recover and authenticate the surviving data.
Preserve the archive through the return journey.

missions.name: Cut the Ash Thread Wire
missions.description: Station Authority requests this operation: Approach an unauthorized tracking installation at Copper Spire, disable its operational components, and withdraw without revealing the client. Copper Spire is a refinery whose older modules have been sealed for years; the shutdown schedule does not match the machinery still drawing power. A public records request links the target to a contractor claiming to perform humanitarian work.
missions.loreHook: A public records request links the target to a contractor claiming to perform humanitarian work.
phaseObjectives: Reach the installation without warning its operators.
Disable the target while avoiding collateral damage.
Withdraw before replacement security can arrive.

missions.name: Borrowed Faces at Hollow Crown
missions.description: Station Authority requests this operation: Trace a data thief with an encrypted travel ledger at Hollow Crown, arrange a lawful handover, and intercept the departure route. Hollow Crown is a derelict observation ring surrounding a dark survey buoy; a repeating signal keeps disrupting nearby guidance systems. The suspect claims the stolen records expose a shell company that has been charging the same debt to three settlements.
missions.loreHook: The suspect claims the stolen records expose a shell company that has been charging the same debt to three settlements.
phaseObjectives: Trace the target without corrupting the evidence.
Negotiate access and secure the handover.
Intercept the escape route safely.

missions.name: The Voice from Lantern Row
missions.description: Station Authority requests this operation: Enter Lantern Row, determine the source of a relay broadcasting contradictory route updates, and return with a verified communications record. Lantern Row is a crowded market under the habitable decks; crowds and competing security jurisdictions complicate a clean exit. Several dispatchers remember answering the same call, but their recordings contain different words.
missions.loreHook: Several dispatchers remember answering the same call, but their recordings contain different words.
phaseObjectives: Reach the restricted communications site.
Diagnose the fault and preserve the source records.
Return with the evidence before the route closes.

missions.name: Bring It Back Breathing
missions.description: Research Consortium requests this operation: Locate a dangerous burrowing animal under a trade route near Ash Garden, contain it, and transport it to a secured holding site. Ash Garden is an abandoned greenhouse complex on a wind-scoured plateau; spores in the ventilation system are interfering with delicate instruments. A rival claimant at Ash Garden has a convincing copy of the same contract, signed on a different date.
missions.loreHook: A rival claimant at Ash Garden has a convincing copy of the same contract, signed on a different date.
phaseObjectives: Locate the creature and establish a safe approach.
Contain the threat without losing control of the site.
Move the secured specimen and crew out safely.

missions.name: Nothing Leaves Tonight
missions.description: Outer Dockworkers Union requests this operation: Find a weapons shipment bound for hired enforcers near Sable Reach, render the specified resources unusable, and leave the civilians out of the conflict. Sable Reach is a chain of drifting mining habitats; a debris front is cutting across the approach corridor. A maintenance log from Sable Reach suggests a technician tried to disable the same operation and was reassigned overnight.
missions.loreHook: A maintenance log from Sable Reach suggests a technician tried to disable the same operation and was reassigned overnight.
phaseObjectives: Find the operational route and avoid civilian traffic.
Disable the contracted target precisely.
Withdraw without pulling civilians into pursuit.

missions.name: The Quiet Anchor Command Signal
missions.description: Station Authority requests this operation: Reach a hostile command relay near Quiet Anchor, break its coordination systems, and survive the response. Quiet Anchor is a salvage anchorage pieced together from retired ships; the local tug network is operating on unreliable power. A maintenance log from Quiet Anchor suggests a technician tried to disable the same operation and was reassigned overnight.
missions.loreHook: A maintenance log from Quiet Anchor suggests a technician tried to disable the same operation and was reassigned overnight.
phaseObjectives: Reach an attack position through controlled traffic.
Disrupt the command or guidance system.
Escape the reacting vessels and hazards.

missions.name: What the Next Shift Needs
missions.description: Helix Transit requests this operation: Carry a sealed medical shipment through Copper Spire, verify the receiving systems, and complete the delivery despite a difficult return route. Copper Spire is a refinery whose older modules have been sealed for years; the shutdown schedule does not match the machinery still drawing power. An old agreement at Copper Spire gives the intended recipient priority access that a new manager refuses to honor.
missions.loreHook: An old agreement at Copper Spire gives the intended recipient priority access that a new manager refuses to honor.
phaseObjectives: Bring the shipment into the receiving corridor.
Verify the transfer and protect the cargo record.
Complete the delivery and return safely.

missions.name: A Ticket Without a Name
missions.description: Independent Route Exchange requests this operation: Arrange passage for a defector traveling with forged departure papers at Lantern Row, maintain their cover, and guide them beyond the local search area. Lantern Row is a crowded market under the habitable decks; crowds and competing security jurisdictions complicate a clean exit. A customs official at Lantern Row quietly provided a safe window, then disappeared from the duty roster.
missions.loreHook: A customs official at Lantern Row quietly provided a safe window, then disappeared from the duty roster.
phaseObjectives: Arrange discreet cooperation from local contacts.
Maintain the travelers cover through inspection.
Reach a safe transfer point outside the search area.

missions.name: The Quiet Key Observatory
missions.description: Lantern Archive Trust requests this operation: Locate a buried observatory near Glasswater Basin, interpret its unusual features, and preserve a usable record for later expeditions. Glasswater Basin is a salt basin around a former survey camp; local weather is distorting navigation and sensor readings. A hand-drawn chart of Glasswater Basin carries a warning in three languages but no signature.
missions.loreHook: A hand-drawn chart of Glasswater Basin carries a warning in three languages but no signature.
phaseObjectives: Locate and reach the site safely.
Interpret unusual phenomena without disturbing them.
Record findings and secure a navigable exit.

missions.name: A Name Worth Catching
missions.description: Outer Dockworkers Union requests this operation: Track a fugitive wanted for stealing workers pension funds through Sable Reach, secure a living handover, and get the squad clear before the charter enforcers of Greyline Security interferes. Sable Reach is a chain of drifting mining habitats; a debris front is cutting across the approach corridor. The file contains two incompatible witness statements; someone wants a quick arrest before the discrepancy reaches a hearing.
missions.loreHook: The file contains two incompatible witness statements; someone wants a quick arrest before the discrepancy reaches a hearing.
phaseObjectives: Find a quiet approach and identify the correct target.
Secure a surrender or controlled capture.
Keep the squad and detainee clear of pursuit.
